root_cause_and_implementation: F-MD-B18-A002-021 named five remediation items. Each was classified against existing authority before any code was written: (1) temporal_identity_hash's correct domain (C02 universe_identity, not C11 market-structure) is ALREADY_DECIDED by the C1 contract's own producer mapping table, which lists C02 ('universe/identity') and C11 ('market structure') as explicitly separate domains with separate producer surfaces -- not a new semantic decision. (2) 'Dataset boundary' folding into that same hash is ALREADY_DECIDED: the C1 contract's own C02 row lists 'dataset boundary' as part of that domain's captured content, and ProducerInputCompletionManifest::temporalMissing() already requires dataset_start inside the universe_identity capture's own selection_context, which slot_hash already covers. (3) Contamination decisions' home (C09 ancillary, the same component already used for benchmark/sector/event-risk) is ALREADY_DECIDED by the C1 contract's own producer table and confirmed by reading ProducerAncillaryCapture::deriveContamination()/derivePriceScaleBreaks() in full: contamination and price-scale-break content is already captured and asserted as part of that exact component's payload (domain=indicator_dependencies) -- not a new domain, and its target bound field (event_factor_hash) is ALREADY_DECIDED by B18ReplayBoundInputIdentityContractTest's own reviewed identityMap(), which maps the whole MD-S050-R0012 bullet (event revisions, verification states, factor-set revisions, AND contamination decisions) to that one field. (4) Eligibility version's home (C10 registry_versions) is ALREADY_DECIDED by the C1 contract's own producer table ('full formula/indicator/price-product/coverage/eligibility/read-model/serialization/build identity'), but ProducerRegistrySnapshot::capture() does not currently capture any eligibility-version concept at all (confirmed by grep) -- remediating this requires reopening Capture to add a new captured field, a materially larger and separately-scoped change than (1)-(3), which touch only Admission. Classified IMPLEMENTATION_DERIVABLE but explicitly deferred, not implemented here. (5) read_model_version/serialization_version/executable_build_identity's home (also C10 registry_versions, which does capture serialization_version and executable_build for real, confirmed by reading the same capture code) is likewise ALREADY_DECIDED, but reading them precisely (rather than as part of one combined payload_hash, already used for reason/formula registry) requires decoding the registry_versions capture's raw semantic_payload_json -- a new Reader/Admission capability not yet built. Classified IMPLEMENTATION_DERIVABLE but explicitly deferred, not implemented here, to avoid a rushed partial implementation of a new capability in the same turn as two other substantial changes. Implementation for (1)-(3): a new private ReplayVerificationService::componentGroupHash(array $components, string $componentKey) reads Reader's own bound_input_context['components'] list (already exposed, read-only, no new query), filters to one component_key, sorts by slot_hash for determinism, and canonically hashes the (stage_code, slot_hash, payload_hash) tuples -- proving both 'which slice was consumed' (slot_hash covers the full selection_context, including dataset_start) and 'with what content' (payload_hash covers the resolved population) without decoding raw capture payloads or persisting a new compatibility-hash column on md_publication_lineage_bindings. temporal_identity_hash now equals componentGroupHash(components, 'universe_identity') directly, replacing identity_revision_set_hash entirely (the wrong-domain field is no longer read at all for this purpose; it remains untouched on the manifest/lineage row for whatever else legitimately consumes it). event_factor_hash gained a fifth combined member, ancillary_contamination_hash = componentGroupHash(components, 'ancillary'), alongside its existing four. A new targeted test, ReplayVerificationServiceTest::test_temporal_identity_and_event_factor_hash_are_domain_isolated_by_component, directly proves domain isolation via three actualBoundInputContext() computations built from three deliberately-different component sets (P140/P141/P142): changing only the universe_identity component's payload_hash changes temporal_identity_hash and nothing else; changing only the ancillary component's payload_hash changes event_factor_hash and nothing else; both are real, non-empty values when genuinely VERIFIED. B18ReplayComparisonExhaustivenessTest's shared mocks() stub, previously returning components: [] (making temporal_identity_hash/event_factor_hash's ancillary contribution resolve to placeholder empty strings), was extended with two real universe_identity/ancillary entries so its existing full eleven-field perturbation suite (P143) now exercises genuine content rather than an empty-list edge case. Governance follow-through: MD-S050-R0008/R0009/R0012 and their MD-S019-R0067/R0068/R0069 Invariant-14 restatements were moved from MarketDataReplayVerificationProofBasis::INCOMPLETE to ::PROVEN, each with its guard rebound from B18ReplayBoundInputIdentityContractTest (which only ever proved MarketDataEvidenceExportService pass-through of a fabricated metric row, never the real writer -- confirmed unchanged and still insufficient by re-reading it) to B18ReplayComparisonExhaustivenessTest's real-path perturbation pair, plus the new domain-isolation test for the two predicates the domain-mapping/contamination fix specifically concerns. MD-S050-R0002/MD-S003-R0003/MD-S050-R0014/MD-S019-R0071 remain INCOMPLETE -- their conjunctions still fail on the deferred eligibility-version and read_model/serialization/build gaps -- and their MarketDataReplayVerificationProofBasis inline comments were updated to reflect that the domain-mismatch and contamination gaps are no longer among their blockers. Verified via a direct PHP require + array-key check that the six moved predicates now appear in PROVEN and not in INCOMPLETE, and that no unintended duplicate keys exist across the file's arrays beyond one pre-existing, unrelated, deliberate duplicate (MD-S050-R0056 in both PROVEN and SUPERSEDED, predating this turn).
